Pseudomonas putida._comment: UWC1 has no whole-genome assembly of its own at NCBI -- every 'Pseudomonas putida UWC1' hit is a small standalone plasmid deposit (largest 587kb, all flagged atypical/genome-length-too-small). UWC1 is a documented plasmid-cured derivative of P. putida mt-2; this pins mt-2's RefSeq assembly as an explicit, visible proxy genome rather than leaving these samples unresolved. Confirmed real: a study of 40 UWC1 runs was found deposited under KT2440's own tax_id (160488).
